answer: Every account pays a full non-refundable admission fee; no bulk pricing exists, one identity or five hundred cost the same per account. The fee is only partially rebated, as nectar, after the account passes its first randomized audit confirming one operator signature per machine. Auditors tag identities matching coordinated injection with an umber flag, and each flagged account forfeits its fee entirely, so a botnet of N puppets forfeits N separate fees. Honest operators reach the zenith exactly once: one fee, one audit, one rebate, with cost never scaling with network growth.
